description: Malaysia于1997年推出的便携相机。配备1:6.7/25mm (3 elements), switchable from normal fixed focus 1 m-infinity to macro modes for 30-100 cm and for 10-30 cm distance。快门速度Speeds 1/90 to 1/300 sec., controlled electronically。使用motorized。

specs.镜头: 1:6.7/25mm (3 elements), switchable from normal fixed focus 1 m-infinity to macro modes for 30-100 cm and for 10-30 cm distance
specs.取景器: Albada type, image framed by bright frame in chosen APS print format, indicators for image center in macro modes, color of macro mode shown in one corner
specs.闪光灯: built-in, reaching as far as 2.4 m with ISO 100 film
specs.英文简介: The Goko FR 2200, or Goko Macromax FR 2200, is a compact camera with 25mm lens for the Advanced Photo system.
